Executive Engagement

One Executive Brief for Every CXC Request

We're simplifying how you engage executives. Instead of building individual executive briefing documents for every speaker, you'll complete just one standardized Executive Brief for your Cisco Experience Center (CXC) request — and it can be generated from your Unified Account Plan that you already maintain. Less prep, more time with your customer. Work with your Account Executive to schedule your CXC.

Instant Agendas That Make An Impact

When you submit your CXC request with your Executive Brief, you'll receive an AI-generated agenda based on your inputs and UAP. Re-generate the agenda, swap in alternatives, and download it as a PDF to share with your customer and your team — building buy-in and ensuring a high-impact CXC briefing every time.
